proposals.text: Tablet checklist for four-point inspection with automatic points total and pass or fail by lot. Alerts merchandiser by message. One site, two checkers trained. Offline mode included. Price: Rs 2.4 to 3.0 lakh. Timeline: 5 weeks.
Custom AI vision platform to detect fabric defects from camera images on the inspection table. Requires camera rig and 3 months of training data. Price: Rs 14 to 22 lakh. Timeline: 20 weeks.
Excel macro workbook for defect entry and points. Limited to one PC and no alerting. Price: Rs 0.4 to 0.7 lakh. Timeline: 2 weeks.
Full ERP replacement with fabric inspection module. Implementation across all departments. Price: Rs 30 to 45 lakh. Timeline: 36 weeks.
Complete quality management suite with training, deviations and document control modules. Price: Rs 35 to 50 lakh. Timeline: 40 weeks.
Basic web form for batch entries. Mentions that it is not validated for regulatory use. Price: Rs 1.5 to 2.2 lakh. Timeline: 4 weeks.
Photograph batch pages and use AI to read and fill the record automatically. No review step needed. Price: Rs 3 to 4 lakh. Timeline: 6 weeks.
Electronic batch record with required-field checks, role-based signatures and audit trail. Validation documentation supplied. Pilot on one line. Price: Rs 9 to 12 lakh. Timeline: 14 weeks.
Tablet or phone entry at each machine with reason code list, auto timestamps and a live weekly dashboard. Two-week pilot on six machines first. Price: Rs 3.2 to 4.0 lakh. Timeline: 6 weeks.
IoT sensors on every machine to capture on and off status automatically, plus dashboard. Price: Rs 11 to 16 lakh. Timeline: 14 weeks.
Shared Google Sheet with a form for operators and charts. No training offered. Price: Rs 0.2 to 0.4 lakh. Timeline: 1 week.
AI to read handwritten sheets and fill Excel. Accuracy depends on handwriting. Price: Rs 4 to 6 lakh. Timeline: 10 weeks.

title: Rice mill: weighbridge and farmer payments

Mobile app for farmers and a cloud dashboard for the owner. Weighbridge integration listed as future phase. Price: Rs 8 to 11 lakh. Timeline: 12 weeks.
Weighbridge integration with a simple slip application, moisture entry, rate card lookup and automatic farmer statements. Printed slips and SMS to farmers. Price: Rs 5 to 6.5 lakh. Timeline: 8 weeks.
Complete commodity trading ERP. Price: Rs 28 to 40 lakh. Timeline: 30 weeks.

AI that compares two artwork files and highlights differences in text, colour and barcode, used as a second check before plate making. People approve every result. Price: Rs 6 to 8 lakh. Timeline: 10 weeks.
Shared drive folders with naming rules and a checklist. Price: Rs 0.2 to 0.5 lakh. Timeline: 1 week.

Shared approval portal: every version stored, customer approves one locked file, plate-making can only use the approved file. Side-by-side compare view for reviewers. Price: Rs 4.5 to 6 lakh. Timeline: 8 weeks.
Complete print management information system. Price: Rs 25 to 35 lakh. Timeline: 30 weeks.
AI app that reads defect photos uploaded by staff, no hardware, results in a week. Price: Rs 2 to 3 lakh. Timeline: 1 week.

Camera station with AI to flag likely solder defects on each board for inspector review. Inspectors confirm or reject. Pilot measures missed and false flags before roll-out. Price: Rs 12 to 18 lakh. Timeline: 14 weeks.
Tablet defect tally to replace paper sheets. Price: Rs 1.2 to 1.8 lakh. Timeline: 3 weeks.
Replace inspectors completely with automated optical inspection hardware from an overseas vendor. Price: Rs 60 to 90 lakh. Timeline: 24 weeks.
Template-based quote generator in Excel with rate tables. No drawing reading. Price: Rs 0.8 to 1.2 lakh. Timeline: 3 weeks.
CAD-integrated costing system. Price: Rs 18 to 26 lakh. Timeline: 20 weeks.

Quote assistant: extracts dimensions and material from the drawing, proposes hours from a rate table the engineer controls, drafts the quote. Engineer reviews and approves every quote. Price: Rs 6 to 8.5 lakh. Timeline: 10 weeks.
Fully automatic quoting from drawings with no engineer review, guaranteed within five minutes. Price: Rs 5 to 7 lakh. Timeline: 6 weeks.
Replace racks with RFID tagging of every item. Price: Rs 20 to 30 lakh. Timeline: 20 weeks.
AI to forecast stock differences before counting. Price: Rs 5 to 7 lakh. Timeline: 12 weeks.
Excel sheet that imports the system report and lets staff type counts. Price: Rs 0.3 to 0.5 lakh. Timeline: 2 weeks.
Handheld scan app for cycle counts that compares to system stock on the spot and flags differences for immediate recount. Price: Rs 3 to 4.2 lakh. Timeline: 6 weeks.

title: Dairy collection centre: milk quality tests

proposals.text: Simple operator screen linked to the fat and SNF machine, auto-calculates payment from rate chart, prints receipts and ten-day statements. Training for operators. Price: Rs 2.8 to 3.8 lakh. Timeline: 6 weeks.
Fully AI-driven dairy platform with demand prediction and farmer chatbot. Price: Rs 15 to 22 lakh. Timeline: 20 weeks.
Farmer mobile app with payment history. Operator entry stays manual. Price: Rs 6 to 9 lakh. Timeline: 12 weeks.
Spreadsheet with a rate chart and formulas. Price: Rs 0.2 to 0.4 lakh. Timeline: 1 week.

title: Furniture workshop: measurement to cutting list

proposals.text: Room design tool for the salesperson: enter dimensions, choose wardrobe layout, see a drawing and an automatic cutting list with board optimisation. Customer sees a drawing before work starts. Price: Rs 4 to 5.5 lakh. Timeline: 9 weeks.
Spreadsheet cutting list calculator. Price: Rs 0.2 to 0.4 lakh. Timeline: 1 week.
AI generates wardrobe images from a photo of the room. No cutting list. Price: Rs 3 to 5 lakh. Timeline: 8 weeks.
Full furniture ERP with CNC integration. Price: Rs 24 to 35 lakh. Timeline: 26 weeks.
